Subject: Quick: EU pilot — bundling / satellite-region pricing question

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for the demo last week — the team is excited. We're preparing an EU-located pilot that will include a small set of satellite regions (Nordics + Central EU) and we need clarity on bundle pricing and any region surcharges for VPC deployments. Budget for the pilot is constrained; procurement asked whether a consolidated bundle + short-term onboarding discount is possible to accelerate sign-off.

High-level ask: a one-time onboarding discount for the first 90 days and a consolidated bundle price that covers host + satellite region egress (we need to avoid multiple geo surcharges for the pilot). If you can put something flexible on paper (even a conditional memo), we can speed up procurement review.

Attached: Asteria_SOW_v1.pdf (SOW draft)

Can we get a quick internal approval path? We hope to sign before month-end.

Best,
Beth Armstrong

Subject: Fwd: Quick: EU pilot — bundling / satellite-region pricing question

Kimberly/Marissa — looping you both for commercial guidance. Asteria (external) is asking for a short-term onboarding discount + a bundled rate that waives regional surcharges for satellite nodes during a 90-day pilot. They are explicitly time-boxed and will sign quickly if we can provide a conditional approval memo.

Proposed starting point (from my side):
- One-time onboarding credit equal to 20% of the pilot bill (applied first invoice)
- Temporary waiver of per-region egress surcharge for Satellite EU (Nordics + CE) for 90 days
- Post-pilot: revert to regional pricing with a 10% recurring discount for the next 6 months if they commit to a 12-month plan on completion

I've attached a quick pricing worksheet with numbers. Key risk: the waiver sets a precedent for geo surcharge exceptions. If we can limit to an explicit 90-day window and require an onramp commitment post-pilot, we mitigate.

Attachments: proposed-pricing-sheet.xlsx

Can you advise authority required for the one-time credit + surcharge waiver? If VP/CFO signoff is needed, please advise exact phrasing we should send externally.

Thanks — Karthik
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Fwd: Quick: EU pilot — bundling / satellite-region pricing question

Thanks Karthik — reviewed the worksheet. Quick thoughts:

1) Onboarding credit: finance will push back on a sustained 30% discount; prefer a one-time onboarding credit (applied to invoice #1) rather than a percentage off ongoing rates. Suggest 20% credit cap or a fixed $X credit (whichever is less) to limit upside.

2) Surcharge waiver: acceptable for a 90-day pilot if we add a clear clause stating surcharges resume automatically after the pilot unless a follow-on commercial amendment is signed. Also require they accept a usage cap for waived egress (e.g., up to 5TB) to avoid open-ended exposure.

3) Post-pilot enticement: rather than 10% recurring for 6 months, I recommend offering 10% recurring for 3 months + a technical review milestone. If they commit to 12 months at pilot completion, we can extend to 6 months.

From an approval path perspective:
- One-time credit + capped surcharge waiver: requires VP revenue (Marissa) sign-off for commercial precedent
- Anything that changes regional pricing permanently: needs CFO (Jonas) sign-off and legal redline (we'll ask Legal to add auto-reinstate language)

If Marissa is comfortable with the one-time credit framework, I'll draft the external memo wording and include the capped egress waiver. Otherwise, escalate to VP/CFO.

Thanks — Kim
Director, Commercial Operations
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 13 Sep 2026 14:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Quick: EU pilot — bundling / satellite-region pricing question

Appreciate the summary, Kim and Karthik. Approve the conditional approach with the following binding conditions:

- Approve a one-time onboarding credit up to 20% of the pilot invoice (or $25k cap) to be applied to invoice #1.
- Approve a 90-day waiver of satellite-region egress surcharges limited to 5TB aggregate across the pilot; any usage beyond the cap billed at standard surcharge rates.
- Approve a post-pilot commercial pathway: if Asteria signs a 12-month commitment within 30 days after pilot completion, apply a 10% recurring discount for the first 3 months of the committed term. Extendable to 6 months only upon completion of a follow-on commercial review (technical/ops sign-off).

Conditions to include in the external memo (legal to draft):
1) Automatic reinstatement clause for regional surcharges at the end of the 90 days unless an executed amendment is in place.
2) Usage cap and overage billing rules spelled out.
3) This approval is a one-time precedent only and flagged in our commercial exceptions register — no broader policy change.

Jonas — please confirm if finance wants to reduce the $25k cap or route differently; otherwise I will authorize Legal to prepare an exec-level conditional approval memo to send to Beth and procurement. Attach my approval brief for records.

Attachment: exec-approval-brief.pdf

Marissa Cole
VP, Revenue Operations — Redwood Inference
